description.value: Walmart Supercentre is a large-format retail store on the Yellowhead Highway in Terrace, serving the North Coast and Haida Gwaii region. It offers a full grocery department alongside electronics, clothing, furniture, and general merchandise, making it one of the most comprehensive resupply points in northern BC. For touring cyclists on the Yellowhead corridor, it represents a rare opportunity to restock nearly any category of supplies in a single stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a supermarket with brand=Walmart and shop=supermarket; the website's page title confirms 'grocery, Electronics, Toys, Clothing, Furniture, Baby | Store 5834', establishing it as a full Supercentre with grocery. Most of the store-detail page was blocked by Walmart's bot-detection CAPTCHA, so specific amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, hot food, etc.) cannot be confirmed from the website. OSM provides phone, address, and website URL as the primary contact evidence.
concerns: Walmart's bot-detection CAPTCHA blocked most of the store detail page, preventing verification of phone number, address, and specific amenities from the website. OSM tags are the primary evidence source for contact details.
